summary: Longeveron Inc. filed an Item 8.01 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing that on September 11, 2026, Nasdaq notified the Company it had regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days, August 27 through September 10, 2026. Prior notices dated September 22, 2025 and March 24, 2026 had granted deadlines of March 23, 2026 and September 21, 2026. The matter is closed; no terms or advisor were disclosed. Watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure and potential reverse split risk.
